Hard constraints preserved: accept-only-if-better guard against the validated incumbent; output shape/finiteness checked by the existing fallback.
Expected-gain check: the corrected bottleneck is solver termination precision on the already-identified active contact graph — trust-constr stops at gtol 1e-13 but with barrier-augmented steps, whereas SLSQP's SQP iterates converge quadratically on the reduced problem — so the falsifiable threshold is an exact-ratio improvement of ≥ 1e-9 over 0.48995, i.e. combined_score > 1.000015, at near-zero runtime cost.

Instead, optimize directly over the 14×14 Gram matrix G: enforce G PSD with rank ≤ 3 by projection (eigen-decomposition, clip negative eigenvalues to 0, keep top 3), center it (zero out the nullspace of the all-ones vector), and maximize an auxiliary t with constraints d²_ij(G) = G_ii + G_jj − 2G_ij ≥ t and ≤ 1 — the *representation* eliminates translation/rotation exactly, so the optimizer's search dimension is effectively 38 instead of 42 and every stationary point is a genuine geometric configuration; degeneracies that stall the Cartesian epigraph NLP (spurious tangential directions) disappear. Chordal embedding of the best G gives points via top-3 eigenvectors × sqrt(eigenvalues), then rescale so dmax² = 1. Validity: fallback validator unchanged; if the PSD projection fails to produce rank ≥ 2, fall back to the current best Cartesian incumbent.
Expected-gain check: the new degree of freedom is the translation/rotation-free distance-space formulation with exact PSD rank-3 projection — a representation the incumbent cannot realize and which removes 6 wasted search directions; falsifiable threshold is exact min_max_ratio > 0.240050605295, checked with pdist before returning.
